extraction_hints: On the H&P 'Surgeon:' tick-box/circle line, the printed options on this mission are RC / DC / KC / ZS. Report whichever is circled/ticked exactly as printed -- do not expect any other initials.

On this mission's OR Record page, the 'Surgeon:', 'Assistant:', and 'Anesthesiologist/CRNA:' fields are BLANK FREE-TEXT signature lines with NO printed checkbox initials -- unlike other Ghana missions where the OR Record repeats checkbox rows. Transcribe whatever name(s) are handwritten there as free text; do not expect or search for tick-box initials on the OR Record for these two roles.

Some packets on this mission are short (e.g. GH16-907, a minor local-anesthesia procedure) and may lack an OR Record, Anesthesia Record, or PACU Flowsheet page entirely. Leave those fields blank/flagged as usual rather than guessing.

Floor Flowsheet 'Date/Time Arrived' and 'Date/Time Discharged' do NOT reliably follow one day/month convention across packets, unlike the rest of this mission's forms (which are month-first). Auto-detected from the vetted sample: 1 Floor Flowsheet date value(s) only fell inside the mission window when read day-first, and fell outside it read the normal month-first way. When a Floor Flowsheet date looks like it's outside the mission window, check whether the day-first reading puts it back inside the window before treating it as a documentation error -- but always TRANSCRIBE exactly what is written on the page and flag it for human review; never silently swap day and month (RULES.md rule 18).
